attempts.summary: Segmented node2 (VLAN 10) and node3 (VLAN 20) on the shared node1-node2-node3 link, with node1 (VyOS) routing between the VLANs via 802.1Q sub-interfaces on eth1. Cross-VLAN ping confirmed end-to-end, tcpdump proved 802.1Q-tagged frames traversing the shared link and being re-tagged by node1's router, and each node was individually restarted with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery of VLAN interfaces, routes, and connectivity.
